But while Graham is pursuing an especially troubling, cannibalistic murderer, Special Agent Jack Crawford teams him with a highly respected psychiatrist – a man with a taste for the criminal minded – Dr. Hannibal Lecter.
shows.tagline: Savor the hunt.

shows.name: Evil
shows.title: Evil
shows.overview: Skeptical forensic psychologist Kristen Bouchard joins priest-in-training David Acosta and technology expert Ben Shakir as they investigate supposed miracles, demonic possessions, and other extraordinary occurrences to assess for a scientific explanation or if something truly supernatural is at work.
shows.tagline: Some mysteries can’t be explained.

shows.name: Daldal
shows.title: Daldal
shows.overview: Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.

shows.name: Wild Cards
shows.title: Wild Cards
shows.overview: A spirited con woman and a demoted by-the-book detective are given the chance to redeem themselves. The catch? They have to find a way to work together each using their unique skills to solve crimes.
shows.tagline: Cop meets con.

shows.name: Malcolm in the Middle
shows.title: Malcolm in the Middle
shows.overview: A gifted young teen tries to survive life with his dimwitted, dysfunctional family.
shows.tagline: Family. The weirdest people you'll ever meet.

shows.name: Vinland Saga
shows.title: Vinland Saga
shows.overview: For a thousand years, the Vikings have made quite a name and reputation for themselves as the strongest families with a thirst for violence. Thorfinn, the son of one of the Vikings' greatest warriors, spends his boyhood in a battlefield enhancing his skills in his adventure to redeem his most-desired revenge after his father was murdered.
shows.tagline: I have no enemies.

shows.name: The Chosen
shows.title: The Chosen
shows.overview: The life of Christ through the eyes of those who encountered him.
shows.tagline: Rise up.

shows.name: Squid Game
shows.title: Squid Game
shows.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.
shows.tagline: The final games begin.

shows.name: Saturday Night Live
shows.title: Saturday Night Live
shows.overview: A late-night live television sketch comedy and variety show created by Lorne Michaels. The show's comedy sketches, which parody contemporary culture and politics, are performed by a large and varying cast of repertory and newer cast members. Each episode is hosted by a celebrity guest, who usually delivers an opening monologue and performs in sketches with the cast, and features performances by a musical guest.
shows.tagline: Live from New York, it's Saturday Night!

shows.name: Psych
shows.title: Psych
shows.overview:
Thanks to his police officer father's efforts, Shawn Spencer spent his childhood developing a keen eye for detail (and a lasting dislike of his dad). Years later, Shawn's frequent tips to the police lead to him being falsely accused of a crime he solved.

Now, Shawn has no choice but to use his abilities to perpetuate his cover story: psychic crime-solving powers, all the while dragging his best friend, his dad, and the police along for the ride.
shows.tagline: Fake psychic. Real detectives.

shows.name: 56 Days
shows.title: 56 Days
shows.overview: After meeting randomly in a supermarket, Oliver and Ciara fall for each other fast, and dangerously hard. Fifty-six days later, homicide investigators arrive at Oliver's apartment to find an unidentified body—brutally murdered and intentionally decomposed.
shows.tagline: Love. Lies. Murder.

shows.name: The Americans
shows.title: The Americans
shows.overview: Set during the Cold War period in the 1980s, The Americans is the story of Elizabeth and Philip Jennings, two Soviet KGB officers posing as an American married couple in the suburbs of Washington D.C. and their neighbor, Stan Beeman, an FBI Counterintelligence agent.
shows.tagline: All's fair in love and cold war.

shows.name: Emily in Paris
shows.title: Emily in Paris
shows.overview: New passions. New fashions. New Emily? A plucky American marketing whiz spreads her wings in life and love after landing her dream job in Paris.
shows.tagline: The best journeys take unexpected turns.

shows.name: MINDHUNTER
shows.title: MINDHUNTER
shows.overview: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.
shows.tagline: History. Pattern. Profile.

shows.name: Father Brown
shows.title: Father Brown
shows.overview: Father Brown is based on G. K. Chesterton's detective stories about a Catholic priest who doubles as an amateur detective in order to try and solve mysteries.

shows.name: House of Cards
shows.title: House of Cards
shows.overview: Set in present day Washington, D.C., House of Cards is the story of Frank Underwood, a ruthless and cunning politician, and his wife Claire who will stop at nothing to conquer everything. This wicked political drama penetrates the shadowy world of greed, sex and corruption in modern D.C.
shows.tagline: There are two kinds of pain.

shows.name: Heartland
shows.title: Heartland
shows.overview: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

shows.name: Narcos
shows.title: Narcos
shows.overview: A gritty chronicle of the war against Colombia's infamously violent and powerful drug cartels.
shows.tagline: There's no business like blow business.

shows.name: The Leftovers
shows.title: The Leftovers
shows.overview: When 2% of the world's population abruptly disappears without explanation, the world struggles to understand just what they're supposed to do about it. This is the story of the people who didn't make the cut.
shows.tagline: We're still here.

shows.name: Patience
shows.title: Patience
shows.overview:
Patience Evans works in the Criminal Records Office in the city of York. She views the world in a unique way because she has a special gift – she is autistic. Patience has a special interest in solving puzzles and a secret fascination and talent for criminology—her unique perspective allows her to connect the dots through clues in a way others simply cannot.

Detective Inspector Bea Metcalf recognizes her talents and takes her under her wing. Patience helps the police tackle a series of challenging cases by bringing her unique insight to crimefighting.
shows.tagline: New detective, new perspective

shows.name: Search Party
shows.title: Search Party
shows.overview: A dark comedy about four self-absorbed twenty-somethings who become entangled in an ominous mystery when a former college acquaintance suddenly disappears.
shows.tagline: There's a difference between missing and lost.

shows.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
shows.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
shows.overview: In a war-torn world of elemental magic, a young boy reawakens to undertake a dangerous mystic quest to fulfill his destiny as the Avatar, and bring peace to the world.
shows.tagline: Water. Earth. Fire. Air.

shows.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
shows.title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
shows.overview: Into every generation a slayer is born: one girl in all the world, a chosen one. She alone will wield the strength and skill to fight the vampires, demons, and the forces of darkness; to stop the spread of their evil and the swell of their number. She is the Slayer.
shows.tagline: Get home before dark.

shows.name: Teen Wolf
shows.title: Teen Wolf
shows.overview: Scott McCall, a high school student living in the town of Beacon Hills has his life drastically changed when he's bitten by a werewolf, becoming one himself. He must henceforth learn to balance his problematic new identity with his day-to-day teenage life. The following characters are instrumental to his struggle: Stiles, his best friend; Allison, his love interest who comes from a family of werewolf hunters; and Derek, a mysterious werewolf with a dark past. Throughout the series, he strives to keep his loved ones safe while maintaining normal relationships with them.
shows.tagline: Watch your pack.

shows.name: Goliath
shows.title: Goliath
shows.overview: Once a powerful lawyer, Billy McBride is now burned out and washed up, spending more time in a bar than a courtroom. When he reluctantly agrees to pursue a wrongful death lawsuit against the biggest client of Cooperman & McBride, the massive law firm he helped create, Billy and his ragtag team uncover a vast and deadly conspiracy, pitting them all in a life or death trial against the ultimate Goliath.

shows.name: Alien: Earth
shows.title: Alien: Earth
shows.overview: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.
shows.tagline: We were safer in space.

shows.name: Snowfall
shows.title: Snowfall
shows.overview: Los Angeles. 1983. A storm is coming and its name is crack. Set against the infancy of the crack cocaine epidemic and its ultimate radical impact on the culture as we know it, the story follows numerous characters on a violent collision course.
shows.tagline: This is how crack began.

shows.name: House of Guinness
shows.title: House of Guinness
shows.overview: Dublin, 1868. The Guinness family patriarch is dead, and his four children — each with dark secrets to hide — hold the brewery's fate in their hands.
shows.tagline: Trouble is brewing.

shows.name: Blue Bloods
shows.title: Blue Bloods
shows.overview: A drama about a multi-generational family of cops dedicated to New York City law enforcement. Frank Reagan is the New York Police Commissioner and heads both the police force and the Reagan brood. He runs his department as diplomatically as he runs his family, even when dealing with the politics that plagued his unapologetically bold father, Henry, during his stint as Chief.
shows.tagline: Honor. Justice. Family. It’s in their blood.

shows.name: The Gilded Age
shows.title: The Gilded Age
shows.overview: It’s 1882 and the Gilded Age is in full swing when Marian Brook, a young orphaned daughter of a Southern general, moves in with her rigidly conventional aunts in New York City. With the help of Peggy Scott, an African-American woman masquerading as her maid, Marian gets caught up in the dazzling lives of her rich neighbors as she struggles to decide between adhering to the rules or forging her own path.
shows.tagline: What's your family worth?

shows.name: The Abandons
shows.title: The Abandons
shows.overview: In 1850s Washington, two families led by powerful matriarchs — one wealthy, one poor but deeply loyal — battle for supremacy on the lawless frontier.
shows.tagline: A tale of two families.

shows.name: The Flash
shows.title: The Flash
shows.overview: After being struck by lightning, CSI investigator Barry Allen awakens from a nine-month coma to discover he has been  granted the gift of super speed.  Teaming up with S.T.A.R. Labs, Barry takes on the persona of The Flash, the Fastest  Man Alive, to protect his city.
shows.tagline: The fastest man alive.

shows.name: Stargate SG-1
shows.title: Stargate SG-1
shows.overview: The story of Stargate SG-1 begins about a year after the events of the feature film, when the United States government learns that an ancient alien device called the Stargate can access a network of such devices on a multitude of planets. SG-1 is an elite Air Force special operations team, one of more than two dozen teams from Earth who explore the galaxy and defend against alien threats such as the Goa'uld, Replicators, and the Ori.
shows.tagline: Saving the world... one episode at a time

shows.name: True Blood
shows.title: True Blood
shows.overview: Thanks to a Japanese scientist's invention of synthetic blood, vampires have progressed overnight from legendary monsters to fellow citizens. And while humans have been safely removed from the menu, many remain apprehensive about these creatures "coming out of the coffin." Religious leaders, government officials, and vampire fundamentalists around the world have chosen their sides.  But in the small Louisiana town of Bon Temps, the jury is still out.
shows.tagline: Thou shall not crave thy neighbor.

shows.name: Cash Queens
shows.title: Cash Queens
shows.overview: When life pushes them to the brink, five desperate friends decide the only way out is to form a gang, swipe some guns and start holding up banks.

shows.name: Death Note
shows.title: Death Note
shows.overview: Light Yagami is an ace student with great prospects—and he’s bored out of his mind. But all that changes when he finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by a rogue Shinigami death god. Any human whose name is written in the notebook dies, and Light has vowed to use the power of the Death Note to rid the world of evil. But will Light succeed in his noble goal, or will the Death Note turn him into the very thing he fights against?
shows.tagline: The human whose name is written in this note shall die.

shows.name: Solo Leveling
shows.title: Solo Leveling
shows.overview: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.
shows.tagline: He used to be the weakest.

shows.name: Arrested Development
shows.title: Arrested Development
shows.overview: The story of a wealthy family that lost everything, and the one son who had no choice but to keep them all together.
shows.tagline: Someone had to get the family back together.

shows.name: Six Feet Under
shows.title: Six Feet Under
shows.overview: When death is your business, what is your life? For the Fisher family, the world outside of their family-owned funeral home continues to be at least as challenging as—and far less predictable than—the one inside.
shows.tagline: Life is pain, get use to it.

shows.name: Primal
shows.title: Primal
shows.overview: A caveman forms a bond with a dinosaur as they struggle to survive in a hostile world.

shows.name: ONE PIECE
shows.title: ONE PIECE
shows.overview: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure.
shows.tagline: A grand adventure awaits.

shows.name: Marvel's The Punisher
shows.title: Marvel's The Punisher
shows.overview: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.
shows.tagline: The truth must be taken.

shows.name: Hell's Paradise
shows.title: Hell's Paradise
shows.overview: For a chance at a pardon, a ninja assassin joins other condemned criminals on a journey to a mysterious island to retrieve an elixir of immortality.

shows.name: Bob's Burgers
shows.title: Bob's Burgers
shows.overview: Bob's Burgers follows a third-generation restaurateur, Bob, as he runs Bob's Burgers with the help of his wife and their three kids. Bob and his quirky family have big ideas about burgers, but fall short on service and sophistication. Despite the greasy counters, lousy location and a dearth of customers, Bob and his family are determined to make Bob's Burgers "grand re-re-re-opening" a success.

shows.name: Call the Midwife
shows.title: Call the Midwife
shows.overview: Drama following the lives of a group of midwives working in the poverty-stricken East End of London during the 1950s, based on the best-selling memoirs of Jennifer Worth.
shows.tagline: In 1950's London, they delivered hope for all.

shows.name: The Following
shows.title: The Following
shows.overview: Notorious serial killer Joe Carroll, after being found guilty of murdering 14 female students on the Virginia college campus where he taught literature, escapes from death row. The FBI calls former agent Ryan Hardy to consult on the case, as he was the one responsible for Carroll’s capture in 2003. Ryan, working closely with an FBI team, including Mike Weston and FBI Specialist Debra Parker, piece together the ever-growing web of murders orchestrated by the devious Carroll.
shows.tagline: Killer instinct.

shows.name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
shows.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
shows.overview: Disregard for alchemy’s laws ripped half of Edward Elric’s limbs from his body and left his brother Alphonse’s soul clinging to a suit of armor. To restore what was lost, the brothers seek the Philosopher’s Stone. Enemies and allies – the corrupt military, the Homunculi, and foreign alchemists – will alter the Elric brothers course, but their purpose will remain unchanged and their bond unbreakable.

shows.name: The 100
shows.title: The 100
shows.overview: 100 years in the future, when the Earth has been abandoned due to radioactivity, the last surviving humans live on an ark orbiting the planet — but the ark won't last forever. So the repressive regime picks 100 expendable juvenile delinquents to send down to Earth to see if the planet is still habitable.
shows.tagline: Survival isn't who you are. It's who you become.

shows.name: The Paper
shows.title: The Paper
shows.overview: The documentary crew that immortalized Dunder Mifflin's Scranton branch is in search of a new subject when they discover a historic Toledo newspaper, The Truth Teller, and the eager publisher trying to revive it.
shows.tagline: From the crew that brought you The Office.

shows.name: Broadchurch
shows.title: Broadchurch
shows.overview: The murder of a young boy in a small coastal town brings a media frenzy, which threatens to tear the community apart.
shows.tagline: A town wrapped in secrets.

shows.name: Community
shows.title: Community
shows.overview: Follow the lives of a group of students at what is possibly the world’s worst community college in the fictional locale of Greendale, Colorado.
shows.tagline: Mastering the B.S. degree at community college.

shows.name: Animal Control
shows.title: Animal Control
shows.overview: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals.

shows.name: The Last Thing He Told Me
shows.title: The Last Thing He Told Me
shows.overview: A woman must forge a relationship with her teenage stepdaughter in order to find her husband, who has mysteriously disappeared.
shows.tagline: It's hard to move forward when you're looking over your shoulder.

shows.name: Once Upon a Time
shows.title: Once Upon a Time
shows.overview:
There is a town in Maine where every story book character you've ever known is trapped between two worlds, victims of a powerful curse. Only one knows the truth and only one can break the spell.

Emma Swan is a 28-year-old bail bonds collector who has been supporting herself since she was abandoned as a baby. Things change for her when her son Henry, whom she abandoned years ago, finds her and asks for her help explaining that she is from a different world where she is Snow White's missing daughter.
shows.tagline: Magic is coming.

shows.name: 2 Broke Girls
shows.title: 2 Broke Girls
shows.overview: Comedy about the unlikely friendship that develops between two very different young women who meet waitressing at a diner in trendy Williamsburg, Brooklyn, and form a bond over one day owning their own successful cupcake business. Only one thing stands in their way – they’re broke.

shows.name: New Girl
shows.title: New Girl
shows.overview: Jessica Day is an offbeat and adorable girl in her late 20s who, after a bad breakup, moves in with three single guys. Goofy, positive, vulnerable and honest to a fault, Jess has faith in people, even when she shouldn't. Although she's dorky and awkward, she's comfortable in her own skin. More prone to friendships with women, she's not used to hanging with the boys—especially at home.
shows.tagline: Boys will be boys. Jess will be Jess.

shows.name: Dune: Prophecy
shows.title: Dune: Prophecy
shows.overview: Ten thousand years before the ascension of Paul Atreides, sisters Valya and Tula Harkonnen establish the fabled sect and female order that would become known as the Bene Gesserit to control the future of humankind.
shows.tagline: True power begins with control.

shows.name: Down Cemetery Road
shows.title: Down Cemetery Road
shows.overview: When a child goes missing in the aftermath of a house explosion, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find them. As secrets unravel and a military conspiracy emerges, all hell is unleashed on South Oxford's sleepy suburbs.
shows.tagline: Curiosity kills.

shows.name: Peacemaker
shows.title: Peacemaker
shows.overview: The continuing story of Peacemaker, a vainglorious superhero/supervillain who believes in peace at any cost — no matter how many people he has to kill. After a miraculous recovery from his duel with Bloodsport, Peacemaker soon discovers that his freedom comes at a price.
shows.tagline: Give peace a f#cking chance.

shows.name: The Lowdown
shows.title: The Lowdown
shows.overview: Follow the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.
shows.tagline: Unearthing lies is a dirty business.

shows.name: Star Trek
shows.title: Star Trek
shows.overview: Space. The Final Frontier. The U.S.S. Enterprise embarks on a five year mission to explore the galaxy. The Enterprise is under the command of Captain James T. Kirk with First Officer Mr. Spock, from the planet Vulcan. With a determined crew, the Enterprise encounters Klingons, Romulans, time paradoxes, tribbles and genetic supermen led by Khan Noonian Singh. Their mission is to explore strange new worlds, to seek new life and new civilizations, and to boldly go where no man has gone before.
shows.tagline: To boldly go where no man has gone before

shows.name: Hunter x Hunter
shows.title: Hunter x Hunter
shows.overview: To fulfill his dreams of becoming a legendary Hunter like his dad, a young boy must pass a rigorous examination and find his missing father.
shows.tagline: Hunting for your dreams!

shows.name: Harry Potter
shows.title: Harry Potter
shows.overview: A new faithful adaptation of the iconic and megahit J.K. Rowling book series.
shows.tagline: The magic begins.

shows.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
shows.title: Curb Your Enthusiasm
shows.overview: The off-kilter, unscripted comic vision of Larry David, who plays himself in a parallel universe in which he can't seem to do anything right, and, by his standards, neither can anyone else.
shows.tagline: Deep inside you know you're him.

shows.name: Rome
shows.title: Rome
shows.overview: A down-to-earth account of the lives of both illustrious and ordinary Romans set in the last days of the Roman Republic.
shows.tagline: Every city has its secrets.

shows.name: Red Eye
shows.title: Red Eye
shows.overview: London police officer DC Hana Li is escorting Dr Matthew Nolan back to Beijing where he has been accused of a crime. However, on board flight 357, she finds herself embroiled in an escalating conspiracy and a growing number of murders.

shows.name: Sentenced to Be a Hero
shows.title: Sentenced to Be a Hero
shows.overview: In a world where heroism is a punishment, Xylo Forbartz, a condemned goddess killer, battles endless hordes of monstrous abominations as part of Penal Hero Unit 9004. Death is no escape, only a cycle of resurrection and relentless combat. But when Xylo encounters a mysterious new goddess, their unlikely alliance sparks a rebellion that could shatter the chains of eternal punishment.

shows.name: The Dutton Ranch
shows.title: The Dutton Ranch
shows.overview: The Dutton Ranch, home to Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler, is a testament to the peace they sought, fought for, and nearly died for, as they’ve come to cherish their 7,000-acre land. With tough times and stiff competition, Beth and Rip do what they must to survive, all while ensuring Carter becomes the man he’s supposed to be.

shows.name: Frasier
shows.title: Frasier
shows.overview: After many years spent at the “Cheers” bar, Frasier moves back home to Seattle to work as a radio psychiatrist after his policeman father gets shot in the hip on duty.
shows.tagline: I'm listening.

shows.name: This Is Us
shows.title: This Is Us
shows.overview: Follows the lives and families of three adults living and growing up in the United States of America in present and past times. As their paths cross and their life stories intertwine in curious ways, we find that several of them share the same birthday - and so much more than anyone would expect.
shows.tagline: This is real. This is love. This is life.

shows.name: After the Flood
shows.title: After the Flood
shows.overview: Joanna finds an unidentified man dead in a lift in a underground car park after a devastating flood, police assumes that he became trapped as the waters rose, but she is obsessed with discovering what happened to him.

shows.name: Prodigal Son
shows.title: Prodigal Son
shows.overview: The son of a notorious serial killer becomes an acclaimed criminal psychologist who uses his unique insight into how killers think to help the NYPD.
shows.tagline: Enter the mind of a serial killer.

shows.name: Desperate Housewives
shows.title: Desperate Housewives
shows.overview: Looking down on her friends and family isn't a way of life for Mary Alice Young... it's a way of death. One day, in her perfect house, in the loveliest of suburbs, Mary Alice ended it all. Now she's taking us into the lives of her family, friends and neighbors, commenting from her elevated P.O.V.
shows.tagline: Secrets. Romance. Murder. All on one street

shows.name: Dark Matter
shows.title: Dark Matter
shows.overview: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his true family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.
shows.tagline: One life. Infinite possibilities.

shows.name: Riot Women
shows.title: Riot Women
shows.overview: Five women along with two riotous backing singers come together to create a makeshift punk-rock band in order to enter a local talent contest, but in writing their first original song, soon discover that they have a lot to say - and this is their way to say it.
shows.tagline: No apologies - just noise.

shows.name: When Calls the Heart
shows.title: When Calls the Heart
shows.overview: Elizabeth Thatcher, a young school teacher from a wealthy Eastern family, migrates from the big city to teach school in a small coal mining town in the west.
shows.tagline: Good things come to those who hope.

shows.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan
shows.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan
shows.overview: When CIA analyst Jack Ryan stumbles upon a suspicious series of bank transfers his search for answers pulls him from the safety of his desk job and catapults him into a deadly game of cat and mouse throughout Europe and the Middle East, with a rising terrorist figurehead preparing for a massive attack against the US and her allies.

shows.name: The Sandman
shows.title: The Sandman
shows.overview: After years of imprisonment, Morpheus — the King of Dreams — embarks on a journey across worlds to find what was stolen from him and restore his power.
shows.tagline: Dream the world anew.

shows.name: CIA
shows.title: CIA
shows.overview: When by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman is loaned out to a clandestine CIA/FBI task force, he finds himself teamed up with secretive and roguish CIA case officer Colin Glass. Together they work covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells, and geopolitical secrets.
shows.tagline: One mission. Two methods.

shows.name: Columbo
shows.title: Columbo
shows.overview: Columbo is a friendly, verbose, disheveled-looking police detective who is consistently underestimated by his suspects. Despite his unprepossessing appearance and apparent absentmindedness, he shrewdly solves all of his cases and secures all evidence needed for indictment. His formidable eye for detail and meticulously dedicated approach often become clear to the killer only late in the storyline.
shows.tagline: Oh, just one more thing...

shows.name: Nobody Wants This
shows.title: Nobody Wants This
shows.overview: An agnostic sex podcaster and a newly single rabbi fall in love, but can their relationship survive their wildly different lives and meddling families?
shows.tagline: We're so back.

shows.name: 9-1-1: Nashville
shows.title: 9-1-1: Nashville
shows.overview: Follow heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour, in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities: Nashville, Tennessee.

shows.name: Barry
shows.title: Barry
shows.overview: A listless hitman is enthralled by theatre acting and becomes eager to leave his old life behind in pursuit of a new career.
shows.tagline: A hitman searching for some direction.

shows.name: One-Punch Man
shows.title: One-Punch Man
shows.overview: The most powerful superhero in the world can kill anyone with one blow. But nothing can challenge him, so he struggles with ennui and depression.
shows.tagline: All it takes is one punch.

shows.name: Sheriff Country
shows.title: Sheriff Country
shows.overview: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.
shows.tagline: Her town, her rules.

shows.name: One Tree Hill
shows.title: One Tree Hill
shows.overview: In Tree Hill, North Carolina two half brothers share a last name and nothing else. Brooding, blue-collar Lucas is a talented street-side basketball player, but his skills are appreciated only by his friends at the river court. Popular, affluent Nathan basks in the hero-worship of the town, as the star of his high school team. And both boys are the son of former college ball player Dan Scott whose long ago choice to abandon Lucas and his mother Karen, will haunt him long into his life with wife Deb and their son Nathan.
shows.tagline: Where nothing ever changed until one outsider changed everything.

shows.name: Vaka
shows.title: Vaka
shows.overview: An insomnia epidemic plunges Stockholm into chaos. A prime minister manages the crisis while protecting his son, a nurse fights to save her infected partner, and a teenager protects her neighbor amid the spreading disease.

shows.name: Big Little Lies
shows.title: Big Little Lies
shows.overview: The tale of three mothers of first graders whose apparently perfect lives unravel to the point of murder.
shows.tagline: A perfect life is a perfect lie.

shows.name: Ripple
shows.title: Ripple
shows.overview: In New York City, four strangers navigate life's challenges while their separate paths unexpectedly intertwine in ways that change them forever.
shows.tagline: One moment can change everything.

shows.name: Grace
shows.title: Grace
shows.overview: Brighton based Detective Superintendent Roy Grace is a hard-working police officer who has given his life to the job, but his career is currently at rock bottom. He’s fixated by the disappearance of his beloved wife, Sandy, and running enquiries into long forgotten cold cases with little prospect of success. Following another reprimand for his unorthodox police methods, Grace is walking a career tightrope and risks being moved from the job he loves most.
shows.tagline: Bright lights, dark secrets.

shows.name: Bosch
shows.title: Bosch
shows.overview: Harry Bosch, an LAPD homicide detective, stands trial for the fatal shooting of a serial murder suspect. A cold case involving the remains of a missing boy forces Bosch to confront his past. As daring recruit Julia Brasher catches his eye and departmental politics heat up, Bosch will pursue justice at all costs.
shows.tagline: Every murder tells the tale of a city.

shows.name: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
shows.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
shows.overview: A Las Vegas team of forensic investigators are trained to solve criminal cases by scouring the crime scene, collecting irrefutable evidence and finding the missing pieces that solve the mystery.

shows.name: The Great
shows.title: The Great
shows.overview: A genre-bending, anti-historical ride through 18th century Russia following the rise of Catherine the Nothing to Catherine the Great and her explosive relationship with husband Peter, the emperor of Russia.
shows.tagline: An occasionally true story.

shows.name: Elsbeth
shows.title: Elsbeth
shows.overview: After her successful career in Chicago, Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney, utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD.
shows.tagline: You will know her name.

shows.name: Cobra Kai
shows.title: Cobra Kai
shows.overview: This Karate Kid sequel series picks up 30 years after the events of the 1984 All Valley Karate Tournament and finds Johnny Lawrence on the hunt for redemption by reopening the infamous Cobra Kai karate dojo. This reignites his old rivalry with the successful Daniel LaRusso, who has been working to maintain the balance in his life without mentor Mr. Miyagi.
shows.tagline: Back in the Valley. One final fight.

shows.name: The Chair Company
shows.title: The Chair Company
shows.overview: After an embarrassing incident at work, suburban family man William Ronald Trosper finds himself investigating a far-reaching conspiracy.
shows.tagline: There's a whole world under the surface and only Ron has any idea about it. And sometimes the two worlds collide, and sometimes they don't. Ron holds them at arm's length from each other. Watch every week to find out when he can and when he can't.

shows.name: Naruto Shippūden
shows.title: Naruto Shippūden
shows.overview: After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work. It will not be easy though as he has amassed a few more dangerous enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki.

shows.name: Sex and the City
shows.title: Sex and the City
shows.overview: Based on the bestselling book by Candace Bushnell, Sex and the City tells the story of four best friends, all single and in their late thirties, as they pursue their careers and talk about their sex lives, all while trying to survive the New York social scene.
shows.tagline: The next best thing to being there.

shows.name: Love, Death & Robots
shows.title: Love, Death & Robots
shows.overview: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.
shows.tagline: The threesome you've been waiting for.

shows.name: St. Denis Medical
shows.title: St. Denis Medical
shows.overview: An eclectic group of underfunded yet dedicated doctors and nurses navigates caring for patients — and each other — while keeping it all together at an Oregon hospital.
shows.tagline: It's quite the operation.

shows.name: Castle Rock
shows.title: Castle Rock
shows.overview: Based on the stories of Stephen King, the series intertwines characters and themes from the fictional town of Castle Rock.

shows.name: Hacks
shows.title: Hacks
shows.overview: Explore a dark mentorship that forms between Deborah Vance, a legendary Las Vegas comedian, and an entitled, outcast 25-year-old.
shows.tagline: Better late than never.

shows.name: The Summer I Turned Pretty
shows.title: The Summer I Turned Pretty
shows.overview: Every summer, Belly and her family head to the Fishers’ beach house in Cousins. Every summer is the same ... until Belly turns sixteen. Relationships will be tested, painful truths will be revealed, and Belly will be forever changed. It’s a summer of first love, first heartbreak and growing up — it's the summer she turns pretty.
shows.tagline: We'll always have summer.

shows.name: The Twilight Zone
shows.title: The Twilight Zone
shows.overview: An anthology series containing drama, psychological thriller, fantasy, science fiction, suspense, and/or horror, often concluding with a macabre or unexpected twist.
shows.tagline: You are about to enter another dimension.

shows.name: Fire Country
shows.title: Fire Country
shows.overview: Seeking redemption and a shortened prison sentence, young convict Bode Donovan joins a firefighting program that returns him to his small Northern California hometown, where he and other inmates work alongside elite firefighters to extinguish massive blazes across the region.
shows.tagline: Face the fire.

shows.name: Gen V
shows.title: Gen V
shows.overview: At America's only college for superheroes, gifted students put their moral boundaries to the test, competing for the university's top ranking, and a chance to join The Seven, Vought International's elite superhero team. When the school's dark secrets come to light, they must decide what kind of heroes they want to become.
shows.tagline: A university like you've never seen it before.

shows.name: Beast Games
shows.title: Beast Games
shows.overview: I gathered 1,000 people to fight for $5,000,000, the LARGEST cash prize in TV history! We're also giving away a private island, Lamborghinis, and millions more in cash throughout the competition! Go watch to see the greatest show ever made!
shows.tagline: 1,000 players. 5 million dollars. 1 winner.

shows.name: Orange Is the New Black
shows.title: Orange Is the New Black
shows.overview: A crime she committed in her youthful past sends Piper Chapman to a women's prison, where she trades her comfortable New York life for one of unexpected camaraderie and conflict in an eccentric group of fellow inmates.
shows.tagline: Every sentence is a story.

shows.name: Falling Skies
shows.title: Falling Skies
shows.overview: Falling Skies opens in the chaotic aftermath of an alien attack that has left most of the world completely incapacitated. In the six months since the initial invasion, the few survivors have banded together outside major cities to begin the difficult task of fighting back. Each day is a test of survival as citizen soldiers work to protect the people in their care while also engaging in an insurgency campaign against the occupying alien force.
shows.tagline: We're not just fighting for our lives. We're fighting for our existence.

shows.name: Lynley
shows.title: Lynley
shows.overview: Tommy Lynley is a brilliant police detective but an outsider in the force – simply by virtue of his aristocratic upbringing. He is paired with Barbara Havers, a sergeant with a maverick attitude and a working-class background. With seemingly nothing in common and against all odds, the mismatched duo of Lynley and Havers become a formidable team, bonded by their desire to see justice done.
Counterterrorism agent Jack Bauer fights the bad guys of the world, a day at a time. With each week's episode unfolding in real-time, "24" covers a single day in the life of Bauer each season.
shows.tagline: A lot can happen in a day.

shows.name: The Last Frontier
shows.title: The Last Frontier
shows.overview: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.
shows.tagline: 600,000 square miles. Nowhere to hide.

shows.name: Loki
shows.title: Loki
shows.overview: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.
shows.tagline: Loki's time has come.

shows.name: Agatha Christie's Marple
shows.title: Agatha Christie's Marple
shows.overview: The adventures of Miss Jane Marple, an elderly spinster living in the quiet little village of St Mary Mead. During her many visits to friends and relatives in other villages, Miss Marple often stumbles upon mysterious murders which she helps solve. Although the police are sometimes reluctant to accept Miss Marple's help, her reputation and unparalleled powers of observation eventually win them over.

shows.name: Palm Royale
shows.title: Palm Royale
shows.overview: In 1969, an ambitious woman aspires to cross the line between the haves and have-nots to secure her seat at America's most exclusive, fashionable, and treacherous table: Palm Beach high society.
shows.tagline: Tune in. Turn on. Wiig out.

shows.name: The Artful Dodger
shows.title: The Artful Dodger
shows.overview: It's a tale of reinvention, betrayal, redemption, and love with a twist. Jack Dawkins is The Artful Dodger, whose pickpocketing fingers have become the skilled hands of a surgeon. He is torn between an impossible love and the criminal underworld he secretly craves. This will require Artfulness.
shows.tagline: The Dodger is in.

shows.name: Gangs of London
shows.title: Gangs of London
shows.overview: When the head of a criminal organisation, Finn Wallace is assassinated, the sudden power vacuum his death creates threatens the fragile peace between the intricate web of gangs operating on the streets of the city. Now it’s up to the grieving, volatile and impulsive Sean Wallace to restore control and find those responsible for killing his father.
shows.tagline: Anyone can fall.

shows.name: Star Trek: Discovery
shows.title: Star Trek: Discovery
shows.overview: Follow the voyages of Starfleet on their missions to discover new worlds and new life forms, and one Starfleet officer who must learn that to truly understand all things alien, you must first understand yourself.
shows.tagline: At the edge of the universe, discovery begins.

shows.name: Outer Banks
shows.title: Outer Banks
shows.overview: A tight-knit group of teens unearths a long-buried secret, setting off a chain of illicit events that takes them on an adventure they'll never forget.
shows.tagline: Bring it on home.

shows.name: Arrow
shows.title: Arrow
shows.overview: Spoiled billionaire playboy Oliver Queen is missing and presumed dead when his yacht is lost at sea. He returns five years later a changed man, determined to clean up the city as a hooded vigilante armed with a bow.
shows.tagline: Heroes fall. Legends rise.

shows.name: Billions
shows.title: Billions
shows.overview:
A complex drama about power politics in the world of New York high finance. 

Shrewd, savvy U.S. Attorney Chuck Rhoades and the brilliant, ambitious hedge fund king Bobby "Axe" Axelrod are on an explosive collision course, with each using all of his considerable smarts, power and influence to outmaneuver the other. The stakes are in the billions in this timely, provocative series.
shows.tagline: Go for broke.

shows.name: The Good Place
shows.title: The Good Place
shows.overview: Eleanor Shellstrop, an ordinary woman who, through an extraordinary string of events, enters the afterlife where she comes to realize that she hasn't been a very good person. With the help of her wise afterlife mentor, she's determined to shed her old way of living and discover the awesome (or at least the pretty good) person within.
shows.tagline: What the fork?!

shows.name: Battlestar Galactica
shows.title: Battlestar Galactica
shows.overview: When an old enemy, the Cylons, resurface and obliterate the 12 colonies, the crew of the aged Galactica protect a small civilian fleet - the last of humanity - as they journey toward the fabled 13th colony, Earth.
shows.tagline: So say we all!

shows.name: Bound by Fate
shows.title: Bound by Fate
shows.overview: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart.

shows.name: Boardwalk Empire
shows.title: Boardwalk Empire
shows.overview: Atlantic City at the dawn of Prohibition is a place where the rules don't apply. And the man who runs things -- legally and otherwise -- is the town's treasurer, Enoch "Nucky" Thompson, who is equal parts politician and gangster.
shows.tagline: No one goes quietly.

shows.name: BEEF
shows.title: BEEF
shows.overview: A road rage incident between two strangers — a failing contractor and an unfulfilled entrepreneur — sparks a feud that brings out their darkest impulses.
shows.tagline: Revenge is best served raw.

shows.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
shows.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
shows.overview: Follow the intergenerational feud between the Joestar Family and various forces of evil, the most prominent of which is Dio Brando and his followers.

shows.name: What We Do in the Shadows
shows.title: What We Do in the Shadows
shows.overview: A documentary-style look into the daily (or rather, nightly) lives of a group of vampires in Staten Island who have “lived” together for hundreds and hundreds of years.
shows.tagline: Don't ask what they do outside the shadows.

shows.name: Murdoch Mysteries
shows.title: Murdoch Mysteries
shows.overview: A Victorian-era Toronto detective uses then-cutting edge forensic techniques to solve crimes, with the assistance of a female coroner who is also struggling for recognition in the face of tradition, based on the books by Maureen Jennings.
shows.tagline: Forensic sleuthing in the age of invention.

shows.name: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
shows.title: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
shows.overview: Georgie and Mandy raise their young family in Texas while navigating the challenges of adulthood, parenting, and marriage.
shows.tagline: The first time's always the hardest.

shows.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
shows.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
shows.overview: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.
shows.tagline: Be there and be square!

shows.name: Rivals
shows.title: Rivals
shows.overview: It is 1986 and Britain is booming. "Rivals" dives headfirst into the cutthroat world of TV where hair-dos are big and ambitions are even bigger. Deals are brokered in boardrooms, as well as bedrooms. Nobody can be sure who will come out on top. With every man and woman out only for themselves, can true love really blossom?

shows.name: Firefly
shows.title: Firefly
shows.overview: In the year 2517, after the arrival of humans in a new star system, follow the adventures of the renegade crew of Serenity, a "Firefly-class" spaceship.
shows.tagline: You can't take the sky from me.

shows.name: The Shield
shows.title: The Shield
shows.overview: The story of an inner-city Los Angeles police precinct where some of the cops aren't above breaking the rules or working against their associates to both keep the streets safe and their self-interests intact.
shows.tagline: The law is just a suggestion.

shows.name: Matlock
shows.title: Matlock
shows.overview: After achieving success in her younger years, the brilliant septuagenarian Madeline Matlock rejoins the workforce at a prestigious law firm where she uses her unassuming demeanor and wily tactics to win cases and expose corruption from within. Inspired by the classic television series of the same name.
shows.tagline: Allies. All lies.

shows.name: Superstore
shows.title: Superstore
shows.overview: A hilarious workplace comedy about a unique family of employees at a super-sized mega store. From the bright-eyed newbies and the seen-it-all veterans to the clueless summer hires and the in-it-for-life managers, together they hilariously tackle the day-to-day grind of rabid bargain hunters, riot-causing sales and nap-worthy training sessions.
shows.tagline: They're getting their shift together.

shows.name: Poker Face
shows.title: Poker Face
shows.overview: Follow Charlie Cale, a woman with an extraordinary ability to tell when someone is lying, as she hits the road and, at every stop, encounters a new cast of characters and crimes she can't help but solve.
shows.tagline: Murder mysteries can take detours.

shows.name: Star Trek: Voyager
shows.title: Star Trek: Voyager
shows.overview: Pulled to the far side of the galaxy, where the Federation is 75 years away at maximum warp speed, a Starfleet ship must cooperate with Maquis rebels to find a way home.
shows.tagline: Charting the new frontier

shows.name: Manifest
shows.title: Manifest
shows.overview: After landing from a turbulent but routine flight, the crew and passengers of Montego Air Flight 828 discover five years have passed in what seemed like a few hours. As their new realities become clear, a deeper mystery unfolds and some of the returned passengers soon realize they may be meant for something greater than they ever thought possible.
shows.tagline: Make the final connection.

shows.name: Sweetpea
shows.title: Sweetpea
shows.overview: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance. That is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control. Rhiannon's life transforms, but can she keep her killer secret?
shows.tagline: It's always the quiet ones.

shows.name: Grimm
shows.title: Grimm
shows.overview: After Portland homicide detective Nick Burkhardt discovers he's descended from an elite line of criminal profilers known as "Grimms," he increasingly finds his responsibilities as a detective at odds with his new responsibilities as a Grimm.
shows.tagline: Mortal. Danger.

shows.name: How to Get to Heaven from Belfast
shows.title: How to Get to Heaven from Belfast
shows.overview: Three lifelong pals embark on a chaotic quest to solve the mystery of their old friend's suspicious death and keep their own dark secret under wraps.

shows.name: Black Doves
shows.title: Black Doves
shows.overview: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

shows.name: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
shows.title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
shows.overview: Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu and other Jedi Knights lead the Grand Army of the Republic against the droid army of the Separatists.

shows.name: Ahsoka
shows.title: Ahsoka
shows.overview: Former Jedi Knight Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.
shows.tagline: Warrior. Outcast. Rebel. Jedi.

shows.name: Last Samurai Standing
shows.title: Last Samurai Standing
shows.overview: In the early Meiji era, Shujiro, once known as an undefeated samurai, decides to participate in a deadly survival game to save his family and villagers.

shows.name: Interview with the Vampire
shows.title: Interview with the Vampire
shows.overview: A century-old vampire from New Orleans reunites with an ailing journalist to recount his life of bloodlust and his tumultuous relationship with the rakish Frenchman who turned him.
shows.tagline: Scream for me.

shows.name: The O.C.
shows.title: The O.C.
shows.overview: Ryan Atwood, a teen from the wrong side of the tracks, moves in with a wealthy family willing to give him a chance. But Ryan's arrival disturbs the status quo of the affluent, privileged community of Newport Beach, California.
shows.tagline: It's nothing like where you live. And nothing like you imagine.

shows.name: Alice in Borderland
shows.title: Alice in Borderland
shows.overview: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.
shows.tagline: Life is a game, you should enjoy it more.

shows.name: Brilliant Minds
shows.title: Brilliant Minds
shows.overview: A rare condition — face blindness — gives an eccentric yet incredibly gifted neurologist a unique perspective on care, fueling his mission to change the way people see his patients. Alongside a team of brilliant young interns, he solves some of the world's most puzzling psychological cases while navigating the complicated relationships that come with the job.
shows.tagline: The doctor will see you.

shows.name: Black Sails
shows.title: Black Sails
shows.overview: The pirate adventures of Captain Flint and his men twenty years prior to Robert Louis Stevenson’s classic “Treasure Island.” Flint, the most brilliant and most feared pirate captain of his day, takes on a fast-talking young addition to his crew who goes by the name John Silver. Threatened with extinction on all sides, they fight for the survival of New Providence Island, the most notorious criminal haven of its day – a debauched paradise teeming with pirates, prostitutes, thieves and fortune seekers, a place defined by both its enlightened ideals and its stunning brutality.
shows.tagline: Take what's yours.

shows.name: Presumed Innocent
shows.title: Presumed Innocent
shows.overview: A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney's Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused fighting to keep his family together.
shows.tagline: Presume nothing.

shows.name: The Resident
shows.title: The Resident
shows.overview: A tough, brilliant senior resident guides an idealistic young doctor through his first day, pulling back the curtain on what really happens, both good and bad, in modern-day medicine.
shows.tagline: They don't care for rules. They care for patients.

shows.name: Entourage
shows.title: Entourage
shows.overview: Film star Vince Chase navigates the vapid terrain of Los Angeles with a close circle of friends and his trusty agent.
shows.tagline: A lifestyle is a terrible thing to waste.

shows.name: The Big C
shows.title: The Big C
shows.overview: A suburban mother faces her cancer diagnosis while trying to find humor and happiness as well.

shows.name: Deadwood
shows.title: Deadwood
shows.overview: The story of the early days of Deadwood, South Dakota; woven around actual historic events with most of the main characters based on real people. Deadwood starts as a gold mining camp and gradually turns from a lawless wild-west community into an organized wild-west civilized town. The story focuses on the real-life characters Seth Bullock and Al Swearengen.
shows.tagline: A hell of a place to make your fortune

shows.name: Grantchester
shows.title: Grantchester
shows.overview: In 1953 at the hamlet of Grantchester, Sidney Chambers—a charismatic, charming clergyman—turns investigative vicar when one of his parishioners dies in suspicious circumstances.
shows.tagline: Faith. Love. Murder.

shows.name: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
shows.title: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
shows.overview: A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.

shows.name: Murderbot
shows.title: Murderbot
shows.overview: In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet... even though it just wants to binge soap operas.
shows.tagline: Built to destroy. Forced to connect.

shows.name: The Wheel of Time
shows.title: The Wheel of Time
shows.overview: The lives of five young villagers change forever when a strange and powerful woman arrives, claiming one of them is the child of an ancient prophecy with the power to tip the balance between Light and Dark forever. They must choose whether to trust this stranger – and each other – with the fate of the world before the Dark One breaks out of His prison, and the Last Battle begins.

shows.name: Halo
shows.title: Halo
shows.overview: Depicting an epic 26th-century conflict between humanity and an alien threat known as the Covenant, the series weaves deeply drawn personal stories with action, adventure and a richly imagined vision of the future.
shows.tagline: Rise from the fall.

shows.name: Resident Alien
shows.title: Resident Alien
shows.overview: Crash-landed alien Harry takes on the identity of a small-town Colorado doctor. Arriving with a secret mission, he starts off living a simple life…but things get a bit rocky when he’s roped into solving a local murder and realizes he needs to assimilate into his new world. As he does, he begins to wrestle with the moral dilemma of his mission and asking the big life questions like: “Are human beings worth saving?” and “Why do they fold their pizza before eating it?”
shows.tagline: Beam this up.

shows.name: Vladimir
shows.title: Vladimir
shows.overview: When an English professor becomes obsessed with a handsome new colleague, her already complicated marriage and career are thrown into total chaos.

shows.name: Bleach
shows.title: Bleach
shows.overview: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

shows.name: Adventure Time
shows.title: Adventure Time
shows.overview: Unlikely heroes Finn and Jake are buddies who traverse the mystical Land of Ooo. The best of friends, our heroes always find themselves in the middle of escapades. Finn and Jake depend on each other through thick and thin.
shows.tagline: They’re not righteous, they’re wrongteous!

shows.name: Line of Duty
shows.title: Line of Duty
shows.overview: A drama about the investigations of AC-12, a controversial police anticorruption unit.
shows.tagline: If you think catching criminals is tough, try catching police officers.

shows.name: Naruto
shows.title: Naruto
shows.overview: Naruto Uzumaki, a mischievous adolescent ninja, struggles as he searches for recognition and dreams of becoming the Hokage, the village's leader and strongest ninja.

shows.name: We Were Liars
shows.title: We Were Liars
shows.overview: One year after a mysterious accident left her with amnesia, 17-year-old Cadence returns to Beechwood, an island off Martha's Vineyard, seeking answers. As three generations of the distinguished Sinclair family gather at their private summer utopia, no one will talk about the accident – neither her childhood friends "The Liars" nor her first love Gat, forcing her to uncover the truth herself.
shows.tagline: The truth will pull you under.

shows.name: Shoresy
shows.title: Shoresy
shows.overview: Foul-mouthed, chirp-serving, mother-loving, fan favourite character, Shoresy, joins the Sudbury Bulldogs of the Northern Ontario Senior Hockey Organization (The NOSHO) on a quest to never lose again.
shows.tagline: Give your balls a tug.

shows.name: Killing Eve
shows.title: Killing Eve
shows.overview: A security consultant hunts for a ruthless assassin. Equally obsessed with each other, they go head to head in an epic game of cat-and-mouse.
shows.tagline: Sorry baby.

shows.name: Robin Hood
shows.title: Robin Hood
shows.overview: A modern reimagining of the classic tale. After the Norman invasion of England, Rob, a Saxon forester’s son, and Marian, a Norman lord’s daughter, fall in love and unite to fight for justice, challenge corruption, and restore peace to the land.

shows.name: Derry Girls
shows.title: Derry Girls
shows.overview: Amidst the political conflict of Northern Ireland in the 1990s, five secondary school students square off with the universal challenges of being a teenager.
shows.tagline: Catch yourself on.

shows.name: Blue Lights
shows.title: Blue Lights
shows.overview: Follows rookie police officers working in Belfast, a city in which being a frontline response cop comes with unique pressures and dangers.

shows.name: When Life Gives You Tangerines
shows.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
shows.overview: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.
shows.tagline: Dedicated to you. Still blooming, always dreaming.

shows.name: Scandal
shows.title: Scandal
shows.overview: Everyone has secrets and Olivia Pope has dedicated her life to protecting and defending the public images of the elite by keeping those secrets under wraps. Pope and her team are at the top of their game when it comes to getting the job done for their clients, but it becomes apparent that these "gladiators in suits," who specialize in fixing the lives of other people, have trouble fixing those closest at hand -- their own.
shows.tagline: Dirty little secrets always come out.

shows.name: See
shows.title: See
shows.overview: A virus has decimated humankind. Those who survived emerged blind. Centuries later when twins are born with the mythic ability to see, their father must protect his tribe against a threatened queen.
shows.tagline: A new vision of the future.

shows.name: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
shows.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
shows.overview: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.
shows.tagline: Not all heroes are super.

shows.name: That '70s Show
shows.title: That '70s Show
shows.overview: Crank up the 8-track and flash back to a time when platform shoes and puka shells were all the rage in this hilarious retro-sitcom. For Eric, Kelso, Jackie, Hyde, Donna and Fez, a group of high school teens who spend most of their time hanging out in Eric’s basement, life in the ‘70s isn’t always so groovy. But between trying to figure out the meaning of life, avoiding their parents, and dealing with out-of-control hormones, they’ve learned one thing for sure: they’ll always get by with a little help from their friends.
shows.tagline: Be groovy... be very groovy!

shows.name: The Terminal List: Dark Wolf
shows.title: The Terminal List: Dark Wolf
shows.overview: Before The Terminal List, Navy SEAL Ben Edwards finds himself entangled in the black operations side of the CIA. The deeper Ben goes into the 'gray', the harder it will become to not give himself over to his darker impulses. Every man has two wolves inside him – light and dark – fighting for control. Which wolf will Ben Edwards feed?
shows.tagline: An origin story.

shows.name: The Middle
shows.title: The Middle
shows.overview: The daily mishaps of a married woman and her semi-dysfunctional family and their attempts to survive life in general in the city of Orson, Indiana.
shows.tagline: Oh, and your family's so perfect.

shows.name: Sex/Life
shows.title: Sex/Life
shows.overview: A woman's daring sexual past collides with her married-with-kids present when the bad-boy ex she can't stop fantasizing about crashes back into her life.
shows.tagline: Time to choose.

shows.name: M*A*S*H
shows.title: M*A*S*H
shows.overview: The 4077th Mobile Army Surgical Hospital is stuck in the middle of the Korean war. With little help from the circumstances they find themselves in, they are forced to make their own fun. Fond of practical jokes and revenge, the doctors, nurses, administrators, and soldiers often find ways of making wartime life bearable.
shows.tagline: Goodbye, Farewell, and Amen.

shows.name: Dexter: Original Sin
shows.title: Dexter: Original Sin
shows.overview: In 1991 Miami, Dexter Morgan transitions from student to avenging serial killer. When his bloodthirsty urges can't be ignored any longer, Dexter must learn to channel his inner darkness. With the guidance of his father, Harry, he adopts a Code designed to help him find and kill people who deserve to be eliminated from society without getting on law enforcements' radar. This is a particular challenge for young Dexter as he begins a forensics internship at the Miami Metro Police Department.
shows.tagline: They're catching killers. He's about to become one.

shows.name: Night Court
shows.title: Night Court
shows.overview: Unapologetically optimistic judge Abby Stone, the daughter of the late Harry Stone, follows in her father's footsteps as she presides over the night shift of a Manhattan arraignment court and tries to bring order to its crew of oddballs and cynics, most notably former night court prosecutor Dan Fielding.
shows.tagline: Court is back in session.

shows.name: Charmed
shows.title: Charmed
shows.overview: Three sisters (Prue, Piper and Phoebe) reunite and unlock their powers to become the Charmed Ones, the most powerful good witches of all time, whose prophesied destiny is to protect innocent lives from evil beings such as demons and warlocks. Each sister possesses unique magical powers that grow and evolve, while they attempt to maintain normal lives in modern day San Francisco.

shows.name: The Mighty Nein
shows.title: The Mighty Nein
shows.overview: When a powerful arcane relic known as 'The Beacon' falls into nefarious hands, a group of fugitives and outcasts, bound by secrets and scars, must learn to work together to save the realm and stop reality as they know it from unraveling.
shows.tagline: When the world needed heroes, they got Nein.

shows.name: Waiting for the Out
shows.title: Waiting for the Out
shows.overview: A philosopher begins teaching a class of men in prison. Each week, Dan leads discussions about dominance, freedom, luck and other topics that have troubled philosophers for thousands of years – topics that gain a new meaning when seen through the prisoners' eyes - both igniting passions and creating tension.
shows.tagline: Freedom isn’t always on the outside.

shows.name: Hunters
shows.title: Hunters
shows.overview: A diverse band of Nazi Hunters living in 1977 New York City discover that hundreds of high ranking Nazi officials are living among us and conspiring to create a Fourth Reich in the U.S. The eclectic team of Hunters set out on a bloody quest to bring the Nazis to justice and thwart their new genocidal plans.

shows.name: The Good Wife
shows.title: The Good Wife
shows.overview: Alicia Florrick boldly assumes full responsibility for her family and re-enters the workforce after her husband's very public sex and political corruption scandal lands him in jail.
shows.tagline: Don't let the name fool you.

shows.name: Fleabag
shows.title: Fleabag
shows.overview: A portrait into the mind of a dry-witted, sexual, angry, porn-watching, grief-riddled woman, trying to make sense of the world. As she hurls herself headlong at modern living, Fleabag is thrown roughly up against the walls of contemporary London, with all its frenetic energy, late nights, and bright lights.
shows.tagline: Hilarious and hurtful.

shows.name: Gossip Girl
shows.title: Gossip Girl
shows.overview: An exclusive group of privileged teens from a posh prep school on Manhattan's Upper East Side whose lives revolve around the blog of the all-knowing albeit ultra-secretive Gossip Girl.
shows.tagline: You're nobody until you're talked about.

shows.name: Monster
shows.title: Monster
shows.overview: Kenzou Tenma, a Japanese brain surgeon in Germany, finds his life in utter turmoil after getting involved with a psychopath that was once a former patient.
shows.tagline: The only thing humans are equal in is death.

shows.name: Chainsaw Man
shows.title: Chainsaw Man
shows.overview: Denji has a simple dream—to live a happy and peaceful life, spending time with a girl he likes. This is a far cry from reality, however, as Denji is forced by the yakuza into killing devils in order to pay off his crushing debts. Using his pet devil Pochita as a weapon, he is ready to do anything for a bit of cash.
shows.tagline: He's a devil who doesn't deserve human rights.

shows.name: Letterkenny
shows.title: Letterkenny
shows.overview: Letterkenny follows Wayne, a good-ol’ country boy in Letterkenny, Ontario trying to protect his homegrown way of life on the farm, against a world that is constantly evolving around him. The residents of Letterkenny belong to one of three groups: Hicks, Skids, and Hockey Players. The three groups are constantly feuding with each other over seemingly trivial matters; often ending with someone getting their ass kicked.
shows.tagline: There are 5000 people in Letterkenny. These are their problems.

shows.name: The Four Seasons
shows.title: The Four Seasons
shows.overview: The decades-long friendship between three married couples is tested when one divorces, complicating their tradition of quarterly weekend getaways.
shows.tagline: Three couples. Four trips. A lot to unpack.

shows.name: ted
shows.title: ted
shows.overview: It's 1993 and Ted the bear's moment of fame has passed, leaving him living with his best friend, 16-year-old John Bennett, who lives in a working-class Boston home with his parents and cousin. Ted may not be the best influence on John, but when it comes right down to it, he's willing to go out on a limb to help his friend and his family.
shows.tagline: Going back to where it all went wrong.

shows.name: Gravity Falls
shows.title: Gravity Falls
shows.overview: Twin brother and sister Dipper and Mabel Pines are in for an unexpected adventure when they spend the summer helping their great uncle Stan run a tourist trap in the mysterious town of Gravity Falls, Oregon.
shows.tagline: Just west of weird.

shows.name: The Originals
shows.title: The Originals
shows.overview: The Vampire Diaries spin-off that follows the Mikaelsons, a family of millennia-old, power-hungry vampires who want to reclaim the city they built, New Orleans, and dominate all those who have wronged them.
shows.tagline: Always and forever.

shows.name: Pretty Little Liars
shows.title: Pretty Little Liars
shows.overview: Based on the Pretty Little Liars series of young adult novels by Sara Shepard, the series follows the lives of four girls — Spencer, Hanna, Aria, and Emily — whose clique falls apart after the disappearance of their queen bee, Alison. One year later, they begin receiving messages from someone using the name "A" who threatens to expose their secrets — including long-hidden ones they thought only Alison knew.
shows.tagline: Time to bring your A game.

shows.name: Oz
shows.title: Oz
shows.overview: The daily lives of prisoners in Emerald City, an experimental unit of the Oswald Maximum Security Prison where ingroups - Muslims, Latinos, Italians, Aryans - stick close to their mutual friends and terrorize their mutual enemies.
shows.tagline: Life's not a word. It's a sentence.

shows.name: I Love LA
shows.title: I Love LA
shows.overview: A codependent friend group navigates life and love in Los Angeles. With aspirations of becoming a talent manager, Maia is stalled out as an assistant while living with her boyfriend...until her longtime best friend and frenzied influencer Tallulah returns.
shows.tagline: It's sink or swim.

shows.name: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
shows.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
shows.overview: Daryl washes ashore in France and struggles to piece together how he got there and why. The series tracks his journey across a broken but resilient France as he hopes to find a way back home. As he makes the journey, though, the connections he forms along the way complicate his ultimate plan.
shows.tagline: Even heroes need saving.

shows.name: Silicon Valley
shows.title: Silicon Valley
shows.overview: In the high-tech gold rush of modern Silicon Valley, the people most qualified to succeed are the least capable of handling success. Partially inspired by Mike Judge’s own experiences as a Silicon Valley engineer in the late ‘80s, Silicon Valley is an American sitcom that centers around six programmers who are living together and trying to make it big in the Silicon Valley.
shows.tagline: How big is too big?

shows.name: Taboo
shows.title: Taboo
shows.overview: Adventurer James Keziah Delaney returns to London from Africa in 1814 along with fourteen stolen diamonds to seek vengeance after the death of his father.

shows.name: The Terminal List
shows.title: The Terminal List
shows.overview: Navy SEAL Commander James Reece turns to vengeance as he investigates the mysterious forces behind the murder of his entire platoon. Free from the military’s command structure, Reece applies the lessons he’s learned from nearly two decades of warfare to hunt down the people responsible.
shows.tagline: Your memory makes you question the truth.

shows.name: Talamasca: The Secret Order
shows.title: Talamasca: The Secret Order
shows.overview: Guy Anatole joins the clandestine world of the Talamasca, an international spy agency for the immortal universe, as he searches for answers to his family's own part in the supernatural world.
shows.tagline: We're watching.

shows.name: The Man in the High Castle
shows.title: The Man in the High Castle
shows.overview: Explore what it would be like if the Allied Powers had lost WWII, and Japan and Germany ruled the United States. Based on Philip K. Dick's award-winning novel.
shows.tagline: Freedom is under control.

shows.name: The Madison
shows.title: The Madison
shows.overview: A heartfelt study of grief and human connection following a New York City family in the Madison River valley of central Montana.

shows.name: Friday Night Lights
shows.title: Friday Night Lights
shows.overview: The trials and triumphs of life in the small town of Dillon, Texas, where high school football is everything.
shows.tagline: Clear eyes. Full hearts. Can't lose!

shows.name: S.W.A.T.
shows.title: S.W.A.T.
shows.overview: A Los Angeles S.W.A.T. sergeant is assigned to lead a highly skilled unit in the community where he grew up. Torn between loyalty to the streets, where the cops are sometimes the enemy, and allegiance to his brothers in blue, he strategically straddles the two worlds.
shows.tagline: Serve • Protect • Unite

shows.name: Fear the Walking Dead
shows.title: Fear the Walking Dead
shows.overview: What did the world look like as it was transforming into the horrifying apocalypse depicted in "The Walking Dead"? This spin-off set in Los Angeles, following new characters as they face the beginning of the end of the world, will answer that question.
shows.tagline: Every decision is life or death.

shows.name: His Dark Materials
shows.title: His Dark Materials
shows.overview: Lyra is an orphan who lives in a parallel universe in which science, theology and magic are entwined. Her search for a kidnapped friend uncovers a sinister plot involving stolen children and turns into a quest to understand a mysterious phenomenon called Dust. She is later joined on her journey by Will, a boy who possesses a knife that can cut windows between worlds. As she learns the truth about her parents and her prophesied destiny, the two young people are caught up in a war against celestial powers that ranges across many worlds.
shows.tagline: The truth lies beyond the world we know.

shows.name: The Brokenwood Mysteries
shows.title: The Brokenwood Mysteries
shows.overview: In a seemingly quiet country town the newest resident, Detective Inspector Mike Shepherd, finds that murder lurks in even the most homely location.

shows.name: Watson
shows.title: Watson
shows.overview: A year after the death of his friend and partner Sherlock Holmes at the hands of Moriarty, Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders. However, he soon finds that his old life is not done with him yet.
shows.tagline: Solve the puzzle. Save the patient.

shows.name: Victoria
shows.title: Victoria
shows.overview: The story of Queen Victoria, who came to the throne at a time of great economic turbulence and resurgent republicanism – and died 64 years later the head of the largest empire the world had ever seen, having revitalised the throne’s public image and become “grandmother of Europe”.
shows.tagline: Defiance. Determination. Destiny.

shows.name: Coldwater
shows.title: Coldwater
shows.overview: A man in the midst of a mid-life crisis moves his family to a remote Scottish village, only to find himself entangled in a dangerous friendship with a sinister neighbour.
shows.tagline: Look out for your neighbours.

shows.name: Skins
shows.title: Skins
shows.overview: Irreverent comedy drama which follows the messy lives, loves, delirious highs and inevitable lows of a group of raucous teenage friends in Bristol.
shows.tagline: The most exciting TV show in a generation

shows.name: Power
shows.title: Power
shows.overview: A successful New York entrepreneur lives a double life as the head of a drug empire that serves only the rich and influential, all while wanting to escape the underworld and keep his family safe.

shows.name: Boots
shows.title: Boots
shows.overview: After impulsively joining the U.S. Marine Corps, a bullied teen finds new purpose — and unexpected brotherhood — with his motley team of fellow recruits.
shows.tagline: Growing up has its obstacles.

shows.name: Bluey
shows.title: Bluey
shows.overview: Bluey is an inexhaustible six year-old Blue Heeler dog, who loves to play and turns everyday family life into extraordinary adventures, developing her imagination as well as her mental, physical and emotional resilience.
shows.tagline: For real life?!

shows.name: Fate/strange Fake
shows.title: Fate/strange Fake
shows.overview: In a Holy Grail War, Mages (Masters) and their Heroic Spirits (Servants) fight for the control of the Holy Grail—an omnipotent wish-granting device said to fulfill any desire. Years have passed since the end of the Fifth Holy Grail War in Japan. Now, signs portend the emergence of a new Holy Grail in the western American city of Snowfield. Sure enough, Masters and Servants begin to gather... A missing Servant class... Impossible Servant summonings... A nation shrouded in secrecy... And a city created as a battleground. In the face of such irregularities, the Holy Grail War is twisted and driven into the depth of madness. Let the curtain rise on a masquerade of humans and heroes, made to dance upon the stage of a false Holy Grail.
shows.tagline: This is a Holy Grail War covered in lies.

shows.name: Weeds
shows.title: Weeds
shows.overview: After the unexpected death of her husband, a suburban mom resorts to selling weed to support her family.
